prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1388; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain with associated stiffness and reduced range of motion, along with lower and mid back pain that worsened the following day. No loss of consciousness was reported. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness over the cervical and lumbar regions, restricted cervical rotation and flexion, and guarding with forward bending. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no radicular symptoms, motor weakness, or sensory deficits. Imaging was not indicated based on clinical findings.

Over the course of 10 visits, the patient received a combination of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, therapeutic exercise for cervical and lumbar stabilization, and heat and cold modalities as needed. Pain levels and range of motion improved steadily across visits. By the final visit, the patient reported cervical pain at a significantly reduced level, occasional mild low back discomfort with prolonged sitting, and near-full cervical range of motion. Home exercise program and ergonomic guidance were provided. Patient was discharged to self-management with instructions to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
